input.title: Senior Full-stack Engineer, AI products
input.text: Join our product team building AI features for 40,000 small businesses across Central Europe. Responsibilities: design and build features across the stack, from React components to Node.js services; integrate LLMs into existing workflows; write automated tests and keep our CI/CD pipelines green; mentor two junior developers. Requirements: 5+ years with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js; experience with AWS (Lambda, S3) and Docker; solid SQL; experience shipping LLM-powered features to production; fluent English. Nice to have: GraphQL, Kubernetes. Remote within the EU or Lyon office.
